changes: Bigger worlds (up to 10×) now shape their world map in seconds instead of minutes, and no longer run out of memory starting up.
The loading screen shows each step of the world map as it's shaped, like "rivers (5/6), face 1 of 2", with the bar moving through it.
If a world's server stops (for example, out of memory), the game now says so instead of only "Could not connect".
